name: AP rejected the config
messageRegex: .*(Value must be|\[E\]|Rejecting config due to strict|Fatal error).*

name: Renderer hung on the AP
messageRegex: .*(hung and was killed|did not finish after).*

name: SSID configured but never on the air
messageRegex: .*(not broadcasting|not on the air|did not come up).*

name: AP advertised encryption it never describes
messageRegex: .*neither a WPA nor an RSN information element.*

name: Client could not connect
messageRegex: .*(Did not associate|DHCP never answered|no DHCP lease|wpa_state=SCANNING).*

name: Captive portal not passed
messageRegex: .*(portal still intercepting|no form found on the splash).*

name: Harness lost the AP or the station
messageRegex: .*(in connect|Cannot SSH|not reachable over SSH|transport failed|Host is down|PipeTimeout|Socket is closed|EOFError).*
